svg.title: bodhan_eval flow: dataset to report
svg.text: Flow: dataset to report, and when costly checks run
Each item goes down the ladder; the right column says when a step runs or is skipped. Nothing here stops the run.
free
paise
tokens
1. Read the JSONL
validate each line; normalise language codes (hi-IN → hi)
2. Filter --langs; attach --calibration labels
labels never reach the checks; they are used only after fusion
3. --generate: fill what is missing
Indic-Translate for translations; a planner picks items for audio by risk per rupee
under the budget, per language; Indic-Speak in ≤220-character chunks
4. Pre-pass per language
length ratio and speaking rate from this dataset (median, MAD)
5. Tier 0: deterministic checks
script / language · format (Markdown, tables, LaTeX) · numbers · length hint
reference chrF++ · waveform stats (silence, clipping, noise, duration)
6. Tier 1: Bodhan round trips
back-translation per segment → DP alignment → omission, addition, drift;
numbers and units via the back-translation; names via Indic-Transliterate;
Indic-Transcribe in ~10 s chunks cut at pauses (≤29 s) → word alignment
7. Second-opinion transcription
different chunk cuts; dismisses words the transcriber lost at a cut
8. Tier 2: LLM judge
sees source, numbered target tokens, back-translation and findings;
2 replicas with re-ordered prompts; a 3rd only when they disagree
9. Dataset level: the same term rendered consistently across items
10. Fusion
cluster signals by span → noisy-OR per category → threshold
→ flag / review queue / dismissed with a reason
11. Calibration (only with labels)
precision, recall, false alarms, localisation; thresholds tuned with ≥5 labels; 2-fold CV
12. Reports
summary.md/.json · items.jsonl · calibration.json · dashboard.html · run_meta.json
with --baseline: diff.md, and exit code 3 under --fail-on-regression

g.text: a bad line: logged, counted, skipped
an empty dataset: exit 1
other languages: counted as filtered
only with --generate
without it: missing translation or audio means
those checks are skipped and counted
small samples fall back to langs.json priors
every item; format only if the source has markup;
waveform only with audio; chrF++ only with a
reference; length never flags alone
every item with a translation; names only when
the source has them (a missing name is a hint);
transcription only with audio; every request
stays under 30 s of audio
only for omission or repetition candidates
only when an LLM is configured (--no-judge skips);
one replica alone never makes a flag;
long texts judged in overlapping windows
checks emit signals; only fusion creates flags
weak hints add weight but never flag alone
thresholds stay at defaults with fewer labels
deterministic: no timestamps or absolute paths;
a rerun from the cache is byte-identical and free
